title: How I'd Run My LangGraph Agent Pipeline on AWS
description: My LangGraph pipeline runs 7 AI agents on one PC, and moving it to AWS as a real production system changes almost everything except the graph itself, starting with the question everyone asks first.

I walk through all 5 layers, from S3 and AgentCore Runtime to Bedrock, AWS Batch on Spot and Remotion Lambda, plus how a human gate that once waited 9 hours survives an 8-hour session and what the media bill comes to for one 63-minute livestream.
